channel.title: Bargain Hunt
channel.desc: Santa sends his naughty helper Elfred to join Danny Sebastian in presenting this fabulously festive episode of the show. Ho-ho-hoping to unwrap plenty of profits are two teams of Christmas shoppers, and gifting their expert knowledge are Roo Irvine and Caroline Hawley. In red are in-laws Gary and Riah. Sisters Claire and Jill are in blue. With ?300 in their pockets, the teams scour the stalls of Newark antiques fair searching for bargains to sell at auction.
